body.name: Perspective tangent-program handle
body.construction: Derive \(\mathfrak T_P\) by linearizing the observed-margin and ATE equations on the optimizer set, retaining the positively homogeneous perspective cost on zero cells and the tangent cones of all active odds faces; estimate this operator by active-set enlargement and apply the Fang--Santos derivative bootstrap through \(\widehat{\mathfrak T}_n\).
